verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's own CLI is documented for use 'through an automated system' to run API tests and 'manage automated API monitoring', so there is first-party support for unattended collection runs. There is no evidence of a built-in scheduler, recurring triggers, or background agent runs; the recurring part would depend on an external system such as CI or cron. Missing for 10: a native recurring schedule or trigger mechanism, autonomous background or agentic execution within the product, detailed docs on configuring monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: With the command-line interface (CLI) you can interact with the Hoppscotch platform using a terminal, or through an automated system. This enables you to run API tests, manage automated API monitoring
Use the Hoppscotch CLI to run API tests, automate monitoring, and manage collections from your terminal.
